# 0.1.1-beta.15

Beta.15 improves bar switching, plugin placement, hosted-panel geometry,
notification history, Health attribution, and Control Center lifecycle behavior
while retaining Shibumi's 24-plugin, one-Quickshell-process architecture.

## Highlights

- V1 can split G8 from its optional second center slot.
- V2 plugin groups use another available region when their preferred region is
  full, and the editor makes slot, divider, and drag support explicit.
- The bar window is now exactly bar-high, also while editing. The V1 editing
  frame, including its border stroke, stays within that window at both top and
  bottom. A dedicated output-local backdrop handles dimming and outside-click
  dismissal, while drag coordinates remain tied to their originating output
  geometry.
- Hosted panels retain provider-owned content height and card placement without
  the former slot measurement and geometry-repair layer.
- Single-instance widgets transfer between slots only after the previous owner
  has been destroyed.
- Hosted widgets detach from the bar before loader teardown and no longer call
  it after its loader context is gone. Network reads one service snapshot per
  derived binding, and Status avoids unregistering click targets from a bar that
  is tearing down.
- Recent notifications can be read from host-owned history when the host exposes
  DND but no popup model. The unavailable Live view stays hidden, while Recent
  supports per-entry dismissal and clear-history through validated host history
  filenames.
- Saved profiles drop plugins that are no longer installed and carry enabled,
  installed third-party bar widgets already present in the current layout into
  the restored profile, including their layout settings.
- Health reads the selected instance log directly and keeps the Control Center
  focused on Shibumi-attributed findings; complete owner-labelled diagnostics
  remain available from the CLI and JSON report.
- Network, Notifications, Do Not Disturb, Idle, system-update embedding, Quick
  controls, palette lifetime, and output-local Control Center restoration are
  more resilient across service and presentation changes.

## Compatibility

Beta.15 targets the repository’s pinned Omarchy 4.0.3 package and source
baseline. It does not update Omarchy or replace any published tag.

Verified on Omarchy 4.0.3 with one output at scale 1; multi-output and mixed-scale
setups were not part of this pass.

## Notes

- Basecamp refresh is unavailable under Shibumi on the pinned Omarchy 4.0.3
  host: the plugin has no widget-local service fallback, and the host does not
  expose its shared service to replacement bars.
- In edit mode, empty V1 slots are interactive; click the desktop or press
  Escape to leave edit mode.
- Quickshell can log `Failed to register with host portal … Connection already
  associated with an application ID` with or without Shibumi installed. This
  remains separate host evidence and is not attributed as fixed by the
  hosted-widget teardown changes.
- `omarchy.bar` handler conflicts can already be present in a shell instance.
  They remain separate host-warning evidence and are not a general allowance
  for duplicate IPC ownership.
- AUR publication remains deferred.
